text:
aisha_sales: Hey team — quick ask. Seed-stage startup NeptuneML is asking for an expanded trial to finish a 6-week POC. Current standard is $5k credits / 30 days. Customer says they need 25k credits and 90 days to finish data ingestion + model tuning before an exec review on 2024-11-20. Demo scheduled Friday. Can we approve a one-off? They look like a potential PLG motion (medical analytics, not PHI but contains deidentified device telemetry).

jon_dealdesk: @aisha_sales thanks for the heads up. Need a few quick datapoints before I can approve: 1) expected peak QPS / tokens per month during POC? 2) conversion signal/expected commit if POC goes well (ARR / monthly commit)? 3) any security/regulatory blockers?

maya_se: For cost estimation: if they run ~1M tokens/day on gpt-ish workloads, 25k credits seems high but depends on model choice. Do we know model sizes/quantization plan? Could they use a smaller open model variant?

aisha_sales: Answers: 1) They estimate 700k–1.2M tokens/day during tuning, drops to ~200k/day in steady pilot. 2) Sales expect a pilot contract of $10k/mo for 6 months if POC passes (so ~$60k ARR), plus upsell potential to enterprise in 12–18 months. 3) Security: they'll upload deidentified telemetry, data residency in eu-west-1 required. They asked for full 90-day window.

rahul_security: @aisha_sales @jon_dealdesk quick check — deidentified telemetry is fine but need an SCC/SAQ to confirm no re-identification risk. Also we need to ensure Private Link / VPC options or hosted with EU region. Are they okay with standard DPA?

aisha_sales: They said EU control plane + DPA is acceptable. Prefer hosted but must be EU region. I'll send over the security questionnaire answers by EOD.

marta_revenue_ops: FYI - rate card note: promo credits are additive but we require a billing tag for one-off grants so we can reconcile. If we grant >$10k in credits we normally need an SDR/AE undersell and a signed pilot SOW or MSA with a conversion commit.

jon_dealdesk: Given the numbers this is borderline. Two paths: (A) Approve 25k credits, 90 days, conditional on signed pilot SOW committing to $10k/mo for 6 months OR (B) Approve 12k credits, 60 days, no commit required. Which one does sales want to push?

aisha_sales: We want path A — the account exec is confident on $10k/mo and exec review is firm date. Customer is VC-backed (pre-seed/seed) and values speed. Can we make the approval contingent on a signed pilot SOW by next Tuesday?

jon_dealdesk: I can greenlight a one-time exception: grant NeptuneML $25,000 trial credits scoped to eu-west-1, expires 2024-11-30 (90 days from today). Conditions: 1) signed pilot SOW or MSA before credits are drawn down; 2) pilot must include a conversion conversation with AE within 30 days of trial end; 3) usage tagged with billing code "neptune-poc-2024". If security questionnaire reveals issues we can revoke. Any objections? :eyes:

marta_revenue_ops: Add requirement that we create a credit ledger entry and set quota ceiling at $25k to avoid runaway. Ops will do the tagging.

ops_bot: System: Scheduled task created — grant workflow queued for approval. Job ID: grant-1934567890-01.

rahul_security: I'll review the questionnaire. If they upload to S3 we need to confirm encryption at rest and IAM controls. Otherwise ok on principle.

maya_se: I'll prep a recommended model/limits doc for the AE to hand to the customer — recommend starting with a 13B open model and enable prefix caching to reduce token cost. Also include an ops snippet to limit max tokens per request.

aisha_sales: Thanks all. I'll get the SOW signed and the security QC answers today. Please proceed with the grant once SOW is attached. @jon_dealdesk please note: customer demo Friday at 10am CET, would like credits provisioned before then if possible. :pray:

jon_dealdesk: Noted. I will mark this as high priority. Conditional approval recorded — will action after SOW upload.

ops_bot: System: grant-1934567890-01 status updated to "pending docs".

aisha_sales: Uploaded SOW to the thread (link to internal drive) and pinged legal for countersign.

jon_dealdesk: Received SOW link. Legal confirm expected today?

marta_revenue_ops: Legal has been looped, good. Once countersigned ops will schedule the credit apply and set quota.

ops_bot: System: grant-1934567890-01 executed. Credits applied: 25000. Expiry: 2024-11-30. Billing tag: neptune-poc-2024.

aisha_sales: :tada: Thanks team! I'll tell NeptuneML credits are live and they can proceed with the demo.

rahul_security: I'll keep an eye on the questionnaire responses and ping if anything else.

jon_dealdesk: Closing thread — one-time exception granted with conditions. Please file a short win/loss note after pilot. :thumbsup:
